entries.subject: Selected model
entries.finding: [Selected model](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/154) and [original counted mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/369/shape.txt) — included unchanged. Convex light-curve reconstruction; fine relief is unresolved.

entries.subject: DAMIT documentation
entries.finding: [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) — coordinate units, pole, period and diameter semantics. CC BY 4.0.

entries.subject: T. Michalowski (2004), Photometry and models of selected main-belt asteroids (I): 52 Europa, 115 Thyra, and 382 Dodona
entries.finding: [T. Michalowski (2004), Photometry and models of selected main-belt asteroids (I): 52 Europa, 115 Thyra, and 382 Dodona](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2004A&A...416..353M/abstract) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: M. Delbo and P. Tanga (2009), Thermal inertia of main belt asteroids smaller than 100 km from IRAS data
entries.finding: [M. Delbo and P. Tanga (2009), Thermal inertia of main belt asteroids smaller than 100 km from IRAS data](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009P%26SS...57..259D) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the documented physical calibration supplies the selected scale. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 80.65 ± 0.88 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented.

entries.subject: Delbo and Tanga (2009), Planetary and Space Science 57, 259–265
entries.finding: [Delbo and Tanga (2009), Planetary and Space Science 57, 259–265](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0808.0869) — retained primary publication; see the body-specific selection and calibration above.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The release supplies no registered surface imagery; the grid marks that gap.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: The survey found no alternative archive solution for this target.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Versioned browser evidence
entries.finding: The README records two browser cases before final integration, with an asset comparison to the integrated files, but no tested code revision for those cases. This is an evidence limitation, not proof of a current rendering defect.
entries.revisitWhen: A focused browser check identifies the tested revision, relevant served asset pins and capture settings, or the original report can be reliably bound to that revision and its dependencies.
